premises.text: Artomatix is an example-based AI that generates varied artistic content (images, materials, 3D) while keeping the artist in the loop for controllability
premises.evidence_span: Artematics is an example-based way of making art

premises.text: Video games are the beachhead; Artomatix Cloud will serve the broader industry from big to small
premises.evidence_span: we've identified that video games are our beachhead
We're going to monetize through a software-as-a-service business model
